standard.summary: 仅影响 Anima/Newbie cache-first 数据集。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.auto: cache-first 数据集自动选 collate。

standard_en.summary: Affects the Anima/Newbie cache-first datasets only.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.auto: Picks the collate for cache-first datasets automatically.
optionDescriptions.legacy: The old pre-allocating loop, kept for comparison.

advanced.principle: 仅影响 Anima/Newbie cache-first 数据集。auto/pad_sequence 使用 PyTorch 原生序列 padding；legacy 保留旧预分配循环路径，用于对照或兼容排查。

advanced_en.principle: Only affects Anima/Newbie cache-first datasets. auto/pad_sequence uses PyTorch native sequence padding; legacy keeps the old preallocated-loop path for comparison or compatibility debugging.
